plain.li: [favour,warm] Tell your people the account between us is clear, {WRITER}, and that we were glad to clear it.
[favour,warm,theirLowtech] What passed between our peoples is even now. We would gladly start owing each other again.
[favour,warm,theirHightech] Settled in full. If your colony needs a hand again, write to me directly.
[favour,warm,call] I'm glad you called about it rather than letting it sit, {WRITER}. It's settled.
[favour,cordial] It is done. Between your colony and mine, nothing is owed either way.
[favour,cordial,theirLowtech] It is done by our custom, and before witnesses. Nothing is owed either way.
[favour,cordial,theirHightech] Consider this the receipt, {WRITER}. Nothing is owed either way.
[favour,cool] You have what you asked for. We are even now.
[favour,cool,theirLowtech] It is paid. Do not ask us for more on the strength of it.
[favour,cool,theirHightech] Debt cleared. Please don't write to us about it again.
[favour,cool,call] There, it's done. I hope your colony is satisfied.
[favour,refusal] We know what we owe. We will not pay it this way, and that is our answer.
[favour,refusal,theirLowtech] Our people will not be told what to give, {WRITER}, debt or no debt.
[favour,refusal,theirHightech] Not this, and not now. Most of our council is sorry about it.
[favour,refusal,letter] I wrote three answers to your letter and burned two. This is the one my people agreed on, and it is no.
[favour,refusal,call] I know we owe you. The answer is still no, and I'd rather you heard it from me.
[greetings,warm,tie:honour:theirs,!tie:honour:you] We have not forgotten what we owe your colony, {WRITER}. Ask when you need it, and ask plainly.
[greetings,cordial,tie:honour:theirs,!tie:honour:you] Thank you for writing. What we owe your colony for {FAVOURWHY} is still remembered here.
[greetings,warm,tie:honour:you] You are owed a favor among us, {WRITER}, and I hope you will not be shy about it.
[greetings,cool,tie:honour:theirs] We read your letter. If it is about what we owe, write plainly next time.
[greetings,cordial,tie:honour:ours] It is good to hear from you. What your colony owes us can wait for a harder season.
[greetings,cool,tie:honour:ours] Your letter came, and with it the thought of what your colony owes us, as always.
[greetings,cordial,tie:honour:due,tie:honour:theirs] Your colony has called in what we owe. It is being talked over here, and you will have our answer.
[greetings,cool,tie:honour:due,tie:honour:ours] We called in what your colony owes us and we are still waiting. This letter does not change that.
[news,cordial,tie:honour:ours] Here is our news. None of it is a call on your debt, so read it at ease.
[help,refusal,tie:honour:ours] You already owe us for {FAVOURWHY}, and now you ask for {HELP}? Settle one before you ask for another.
[help,warm,tie:honour:theirs] This is not the debt we owe you, {WRITER}, only {HELP} between friends. The debt still stands.
[warning,cordial,tie:honour:ours] A warning is a kindness. It does not settle what your colony owes us, but it will be remembered.
[invitation,warm,tie:honour:theirs] We owe your colony more than a visit, but I will come all the same.
[condolences,warm,tie:honour:theirs] We owe your colony already, and now we owe it this kindness too. Thank you for writing.
[pact,warm] Yes, {WRITER}, and gladly. Tell your people they have friends here now.
[pact,warm,theirLowtech] We will swear it as our people swear, before witnesses, and hold to it the year round.
[pact,warm,letter] Your letter was read aloud to our people, and nobody spoke against it. We accept.
[pact,cordial,theirHightech] We've read the terms and we accept. Our copy will be signed today.
[pact,cordial,call] Good to hear you on the line, {WRITER}. You have our yes.
[pact,cool,letter] We have your letter, and we will do as it asks.
[pact,cool,theirLowtech] It is heard, and it will be done as your words ask.
[pact,cool,theirHightech] Noted, and acted on as you requested.
[pact,cool,call] Understood, {WRITER}. We'll do as you ask.
[pact,curt] Your colony ends the pact. So be it.
[pact,curt,theirLowtech] The oath is set aside, as you ask. We will remember who asked.
[pact,curt,theirHightech] Agreement ended at your request. Our records are updated.
[pact,refusal] Then there is nothing more to say about a pact this year, {WRITER}.
[pact,refusal,theirLowtech] There will be no oath between us this year.
[pact,refusal,call] I'm sorry, {WRITER}. There won't be a pact between us this year.
[greetings,cordial,tie:pact:defence,theirLowtech] Our watchers look your way at night now. Write when you like, and light your fire when you must.
[greetings,warm,tie:pact:trade] The traders here look forward to your colony's cart more than to most caravans.
[news,cordial,tie:pact] Here is our news, and since we stand together, I have left nothing out.
[help,warm,tie:pact] Friends under a pact should not have to ask twice. We send {HELP}.
[help,refusal,tie:pact] It pains me, with the pact between us, but we cannot spare {HELP} just now.
[warning,warm,tie:pact:defence] Thank you. If it comes to a fight at our walls, we know whom to call.
[invitation,warm,tie:pact] I will come, and bring news of how the year has gone for us.
[greetings,cool,tie:pact] We have your letter. The pact holds, which is the main thing between us.
[greetings,cordial,tie:pact:due] Forgive a short letter. There is a call between our peoples, and it has everyone's attention.
[condolences,warm,tie:pact] Your words mean a great deal, coming from a people we are sworn to. Thank you.
[truce,cordial,war,theirLowtech] We accept your terms, and we will send our envoy under our sign of parley if we can. See that your people keep their hands still.
[truce,cordial,war,theirHightech] Terms acceptable. We'll make it official at your gate, or by word if nobody can vouch for our envoy.
[truce,cordial,war] This has gone on long enough for both of us. We accept your terms.
[truce,cool,war] A truce, then. We will see what your word is worth.
[truce,cool,war,letter] We read your terms twice before we agreed to them. Do not make us regret it.
[truce,refusal,war] Ask again when you have something we want.
[truce,refusal,war,theirLowtech] Our fighters would not forgive us for it. No truce.
[truce,refusal,war,theirHightech] No. We aren't finished with your colony yet.
[truce,refusal,war,call] You've said your piece. The answer is no, and this call is over.
[greetings,cool,tie:truce:ours] Your colony asked for this truce, and we are keeping it. That is as far as our goodwill goes.
[greetings,cordial,tie:truce] The truce holds on our side. I hope your people can say the same.
[warning,cordial,tie:truce] A warning from the people we were at war with. Strange times, and thank you.
[help,refusal,tie:truce] A truce is not a friendship. We will not send {HELP}.
[condolences,cool,tie:truce] We read your words about our dead. Under the truce we can accept them, and we do.
[greetings,cordial,tie:truce:due] The truce is nearly over. I hope it ends as a peace, and I will say so to anyone here who asks.
[ransom,warm] We are glad to settle this, {WRITER}, and you will hear from us soon.
[ransom,cordial,theirLowtech] We will settle it by our custom. You will hear from us before long.
[ransom,cordial,theirHightech] Your proposal works for us. Expect to hear from us shortly.
[ransom,cordial,call] Thanks for calling, {WRITER}. You'll hear from us about it.
[ransom,cool,letter] Fine. We'll settle this, but not in letters.
[ransom,cool,war,theirLowtech] We do not love your colony, but we want our own back. Watch your gate.
[ransom,refusal,war,theirHightech] We don't negotiate with your colony, not over prisoners and not over anything.
[ransom,refusal,letter] Your letter was read and set aside. We will not bargain over this one.
[ransom,refusal,theirLowtech] The one you hold shamed us by being taken. We will not bargain for them.
[ransom,refusal,call] No, {WRITER}. We're not bargaining over prisoners today.
[greetings,cordial,ransom:theirs] Thank you for writing. Please see that the one of ours you hold is kept warm.
[greetings,curt,ransom:theirs] You hold one of ours and send us letters. Send them home instead.
[greetings,cordial,ransom:held] We know you are thinking of the one of yours we hold. Your letter says so between the lines.
[news,cool,ransom:held] Our news, since you ask. You will notice we say nothing of the one of yours we hold.
[help,refusal,ransom:held] We hold one of yours, and you ask us for {HELP}? Settle that first.
[condolences,cordial,ransom:theirs] Your sympathy is kind. Kinder still would be the one of ours in your cells, walked home.
[envoy,warm,theirLowtech] Our envoy will come to you, and will sit at your table as our custom asks.
[envoy,warm,theirHightech] Approved, {WRITER}. Our envoy is already asking what to pack.
[envoy,cordial] Our envoy will come for the season. A bed of their own would be a kindness, if you have one.
[envoy,cordial,theirLowtech] Our envoy will come, with an attendant, as is proper.
[envoy,cool] Very well, our envoy will come. We will be reading their letters closely.
[envoy,cool,theirHightech] Approved. Our envoy will report on everything, so keep that in mind.
[envoy,refusal] We need our envoy at home this season. Ask us again another time.
[envoy,refusal,theirHightech] Request declined. Our envoy is needed elsewhere this season.
[envoy,refusal,call] Not this season, {WRITER}. Our envoy can't be spared.
[greetings,cordial,envoy:here] Our envoy's letters reach us, and we read every one. Yours is welcome beside them.
[greetings,cool,envoy:here] We have your letter, and our envoy's letters too. We will see whether they agree.
[greetings,warm,envoy:ours] Your envoy is good company, {WRITER}, and so is your letter.
[news,cordial,envoy:ours] Your envoy will have written some of this home already. Here is our side of it.
[help,cordial,envoy:ours] With your envoy living among us, it would be strange to refuse. We send {HELP}.
[invitation,cordial,envoy:ours] I will come, and I will bring word of your envoy with me.
[favourask,us] We helped your people once, and now we need something back.
[favourask,us,theirLowtech] By your own ways, a debt like yours is paid when it's asked for.
[favourask,us,abrasive] Your people owe us, and I'm here to collect.
[favourask,us,kind] I hate to ask, but your people owe us, and we need it.
[favourtalk,them] What is it your colony needs most?
[favourtalk,them,theirLowtech] A debt between peoples is no small thing to call in.
[favourtalk,us] We wouldn't ask over something small.
[favourtalk,us] Whatever you can do will be remembered.
[favouryes,them] Then it's settled, and gladly.
[favouryes,them,kind] Of course, I'd have offered if you hadn't asked.
[favouryes,them,theirLowtech] It will be done, as our ways ask.
[favourno,them,abrasive] You ask too much, debt or no debt.
[favourno,them,theirLowtech] My people would never agree to that, whatever we owe.
[favourno,them] I can't promise that, and I won't pretend I can.
[pactask,us] We'd like your people to stand with ours for a year.
[pactask,us,theirHightech] I'd like to propose an agreement between our peoples.
[pactask,us,theirLowtech] Would your people swear an oath with ours, before witnesses?
[pacttalk,them] A year is a long time to promise for.
[pacttalk,them] And if we're called away the day you need us?
[pacttalk,us] We'd come when you called, and expect the same.
[pactyes,them] Then a year it is, and may we both get through it.
[pactyes,them,theirHightech] Agreed, and I'll have it written up at home.
[pactno,them] Not this year, I'm afraid.
[pactno,them,abrasive] You haven't earned that from us yet.
[parley,us] Speak your terms, and I'll speak ours.
[parley,us] Nobody here will raise a hand to you today.
[parley,us,theirHightech] Let's get this witnessed and done.
[parley,us,abrasive] Say what you came to say.
[parleyterms,them] No raids from our side while it holds, that's the heart of it.
[parleyterms,them,theirLowtech] My people swear it the old way, and so must you.
[parleyterms,them,theirHightech] Our side's terms, exactly as agreed.
[parleyterms,them] Keep your side, and we'll keep ours.
[parleysworn,them] It's sworn, and may neither of us regret it.
[parleysworn,them,theirLowtech] Sworn before witnesses, as it should be.
[parleysworn,them] Done, and nobody bled for it.
[ransompay,us] This is everything you asked for, so count it in front of me.
[ransompay,us,abrasive] Take it, and bring them back unhurt.
[ransompay,us,kind] Here, and tell them we're waiting for them at home.
[ransompay,us,theirLowtech] Here is the price, and our word that it's all there.
[ransomthanks,them] Good, yours will be on the road home soon.
[ransomthanks,them,theirHightech] Payment received, and we'll release them as agreed.
[ransomthanks,them,theirLowtech] It is paid, and our word holds.
[ransomset,them] Here's our price, set down as promised.
[ransomset,them,theirHightech] Payment's here, so release our person.
[ransomset,them,abrasive] It's all there, so don't keep us waiting.
[exchangegate,them] Go on, your people are waiting for you.
[exchangegate,them] You're free, so walk on to your own.
[exchangegate,them,theirLowtech] Go home, the bargain is kept.
[exchangegate,them,abrasive] Off you go, and don't get caught again.
[exchangeask,us] We'd trade one of yours for one of ours, at our gate.
[exchangeask,us,theirHightech] I'd like to propose a straight exchange of prisoners.
[exchangetalk,them] Is ours being treated well?
[exchangetalk,us] Fed and kept warm, as we'd hope ours are.
[exchangeyes,them] Agreed, one for one at your gate.
[exchangeyes,them,kind] Done, and I'll be glad to see ours home.
[exchangeno,them] Not for that one.
[exchangeno,them,theirHightech] The trade doesn't balance for us, I'm sorry.
[envoyletter,them] Mind the seal, and don't read it on the road.
[envoyletter,them,theirLowtech] Carry it straight home, and tell them I'm fed.
[envoyletter,them,theirHightech] Straight to the council, and ask them for a reply.
[envoyletter,them] Tell my family I'm well, and give them this one first.
[signalfire,us] That should be seen from a long way off.
[signalfire,us] Come on, catch.
[signalfire,us,night] They'll see this one a long way off in the dark.
[signalfire,us,rain|snow] Burn, curse the weather, burn.
[signalfire,us] Now we wait, and hope someone's watching.
[signalfire,us,abrasive] If they can't see this, they aren't looking.
[signalfire,us,lowtech] Let their watchers see it from the hills.
